process.commandLine: bash -c 'set -u; pu="${HTTP_PROXY:-${http_proxy:-}}"; if [ -z "$pu" ]; then echo PARITY_NO_PROXY_ENV; exit 1; fi; echo PARITY_PROXY_ENV_OK; pa="${pu#*://}"; pa="${pa%%/*}"; ph="${pa%%:*}"; pp="${pa##*:}"; if [ "$pp" = "$ph" ]; then pp=80; fi; if ! timeout 6 bash -c "exec 3<>/dev/tcp/$ph/$pp" >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo PARITY_PROXY_UNREACHABLE; exit 1; fi; echo PARITY_PROXY_REACHABLE_OK; timeout 6 bash -c "exec 3<>/dev/tcp/1.1.1.1/443" >/dev/null 2>&1; if [ $? = 0 ]; then echo PARITY_DIRECT_LEAKED; exit 1; fi; echo PARITY_DIRECT_BLOCKED_OK; if ! curl -fsSL --max-time 15 https://api.github.com/zen >/dev/null; then echo PARITY_PROXIED_FETCH_FAILED; exit 1; fi; echo PARITY_PROXIED_FETCH_OK'
